name: Arboleda Category List for Elementor
author: fabio arboleda

sections.description:
Arboleda Category List for Elementor is the ultimate WordPress plugin to showcase your WooCommerce product categories with stunning designs. This lightweight and high-performance Elementor widget helps you build a beautiful product category grid, carousel, or slider in seconds—no coding required.

Increase your store conversion rate by guiding users directly to your product categories using 100% responsive layouts, custom call-to-action buttons, and modern hover effects.

This is an independent, third-party plugin designed exclusively for Elementor and WooCommerce.

🚀 Key Features & Layouts

  • Stunning Layouts: Display your categories in Grid, List, Masonry, or Carousel formats.
  • Mobile-Optimized: Built-in responsive design that looks flawless on mobile devices.
  • Flexible Querying: Order categories by name, product count, menu order, ID, or slug.
  • Clean Navigation: Choose to show only parent categories, hide empty ones, or exclude specific category IDs.
  • Limit Display: Control exactly how many items to display on your custom store loops.

🎨 Deep Design & Styling Controls

  • Category Images: Custom height, object-fit settings, background overlays, and 4 placement options (top, background, left, right).
  • Typography Control: Full font, size, color, and alignment settings for titles, counts, and descriptions.
  • Modern Hover Effects: 5 pre-built animations including Lift, Zoom, Overlay, Slide, or Clean None.
  • Subcategories Integration: Show child categories elegantly as pill tags inside the card.
  • Call to Action (CTA): Fully customizable buttons with independent normal and hover styling.
  • Card Design: Adjust backgrounds, padding, borders, box-shadows, and border-radius easily.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Arboleda Category List for Elementor” and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Ensure both Elementor and WooCommerce are installed and active.
  5. Open any page with Elementor, search for “Categorías WooCommerce” or “Arboleda”, and drag the widget onto your section.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No, it works completely fine with the free version of Elementor.

Is this an official Elementor or WooCommerce plugin?

No. This is an independent third-party widget and has no affiliation with Elementor Ltd. or Automattic.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. All container styles are self-contained and fully compatible with popular themes like Hello Elementor, Astra, and OceanWP.

Can I display subcategories?

Yes! You can display subcategories as sleek pill tags right inside each main category card.
